method: Canonical gate metadata and target task rows read through readGateChecks after both gates exited. productReadLog paths are made repository-relative. Standalone values come from measurements.json labels ending in alone-reviewed; wrapper duration and outer command wall time remain distinct. Gate helper records OS 1/5/15-minute load averages before, every nominal five seconds, and after execution on the 16-CPU host. Task load brackets are the nearest samples at or before start and at or after finish; they are sampled observations, not exact instantaneous task-boundary load. Concurrent tasks and scheduler lanes are retained from the canonical row. Load association does not establish the cause of a timing difference.
